svg.title: Frozen supervised warm-up · combat TEST learning curve

cc:Work.dc:title: Frozen supervised warm-up · combat TEST learning curve
cc:Work.dc:description: fresh_start_v1 · exact argmax, actor-only singleton CPU TEST · n=28,676 complete combat rows per model. 95% whole-WORLD bootstrap CIs; label-weighted. Agreement uses the paired full-FIT contrast annotation; soft-CE arm intervals are descriptive. Teacher is native-assisted; not certified public-only. Independent repeat agreement is a REFERENCE, not a strict ceiling. Overall repeat REFERENCE: 71.01% [68.95, 73.08]; n=3,001 repeat rows / 351 worlds (separate from the TEST cohort). High-confidence repeat REFERENCE: 99.28% [98.59, 99.85]; target maximum ≥0.75. High-confidence full-FIT TEST agreement: new 84.95% vs old 85.64%; paired new − old -0.69 pp [-1.66, +0.24]. Old control fitted at full FIT only; its line is not an old learning curve and supports no data-efficiency comparison.

g.text: Frozen supervised warm-up · combat TEST learning curve
fresh_start_v1 · exact argmax, actor-only singleton CPU TEST · n=28,676 complete combat rows per model.
95% whole-WORLD bootstrap CIs; label-weighted. Agreement uses the paired full-FIT contrast annotation; soft-CE arm intervals are descriptive.
Teacher is native-assisted; not certified public-only. Independent repeat agreement is a REFERENCE, not a strict ceiling.
Overall repeat REFERENCE: 71.01% [68.95, 73.08]; n=3,001 repeat rows / 351 worlds (separate from the TEST cohort).
High-confidence full-FIT TEST agreement: new 84.95% vs old 85.64%; paired new − old -0.69 pp [-1.66, +0.24].
Old control fitted at full FIT only; its line is not an old learning curve and supports no data-efficiency comparison.
